00119 - (void)setFormat
00120 {
00121  memset(&format, 0, sizeof(AudioStreamBasicDescription));
00122  format.mFormatID = kAudioFormatLinearPCM;
00123  int sampleSize = sizeof(AudioSampleType);
00124  format.mFormatFlags = kAudioFormatFlagsCanonical;
00125  format.mBitsPerChannel = 8 * sampleSize;
00126  format.mChannelsPerFrame = NUM_CHANNELS;
00127  format.mFramesPerPacket = 1;
00128  format.mBytesPerPacket = format.mBytesPerFrame = sampleSize;
00129  format.mFormatFlags |= kAudioFormatFlagIsNonInterleaved;

00155  
00156  return 0;

00160 static inline void audioFloatToShort(float *src, short* dst, unsigned int length)
00161 {
00162  static const float scale = 32767.f;
00163  int temp[16] UGEN_ALIGN; 
00164  int *tempa = temp;
00165  int *tempb = temp+8;
00166  
00167  unsigned int numVectors = length >> 4U;
00168  unsigned int numScalars = length & 15U;
00169  
00170  VFP_FIXED_16_VECTOR_MUL_SCALAR_FTI_LOAD(&scale);
00171  
00172  while(numVectors--)
00173  {
00174   VFP_FIXED_16_VECTOR_MUL_SCALAR_FTI_SAVE(src, tempa, tempb);
00175   
00176   dst[ 0] = (short)temp[ 0];
00177   dst[ 1] = (short)temp[ 1];
00178   dst[ 2] = (short)temp[ 2];
00179   dst[ 3] = (short)temp[ 3];
00180   dst[ 4] = (short)temp[ 4];
00181   dst[ 5] = (short)temp[ 5];
00182   dst[ 6] = (short)temp[ 6];
00183   dst[ 7] = (short)temp[ 7];
00184   dst[ 8] = (short)temp[ 8];
00185   dst[ 9] = (short)temp[ 9];
00186   dst[10] = (short)temp[10];
00187   dst[11] = (short)temp[11];
00188   dst[12] = (short)temp[12];
00189   dst[13] = (short)temp[13];
00190   dst[14] = (short)temp[14];
00191   dst[15] = (short)temp[15];
00192   dst += 16;
00193  }
00194  
00195  while(numScalars--)
00196  {
00197   *dst++ = (short)(*src++ * scale);
00198  } 
00199 }

00201 static inline void audioFloatToShortChannels(float *src[], AudioBufferList* dst, unsigned int length, unsigned int numChannels)
00202 {
00203  VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM_ASM;
00204  VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ASM(7);

00206  for (UInt32 channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00207  {
00208   AudioSampleType *audioUnitBuffer = (AudioSampleType*)dst->mBuffers[channel].mData;  
00209   audioFloatToShort(src[channel], audioUnitBuffer, length);
00210  }
00211  
00212  VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ZERO_ASM;
00213  VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB_ASM;
00214 }

00432 - (OSStatus)renderCallback:(UInt32)inNumberFrames 
00433      withActionFlags:(AudioUnitRenderActionFlags*)ioActionFlags
00434       atTimeStamp:(const AudioTimeStamp*)inTimeStamp 
00435       withBuffers:(AudioBufferList*)ioData
00436 {
00437  OSStatus err = 0;
00438  
00439  if(inNumberFrames > bufferSize)
00440  {
00441   delete [] floatBuffer;
00442   bufferSize = inNumberFrames;
00443   
00444   floatBuffer = new float[inNumberFrames * NUM_CHANNELS];
00445  }
00446  
00447  long blockID = UGen::getNextBlockID(inNumberFrames);
00448  
00449  float *floatBufferData[2];
00450  floatBufferData[0] = floatBuffer;
00451  floatBufferData[1] = floatBufferData[0] + inNumberFrames; 
00452   
00453  if(audioInputIsAvailable)
00454  {
00455   err = AudioUnitRender(rioUnit, ioActionFlags, inTimeStamp, 1, inNumberFrames, ioData);
00456   if (err) { printf("renderCallback: error %d\n", (int)err); return err; }
00457   
00458   audioShortToFloatChannels(ioData, floatBufferData, inNumberFrames, numInputChannels);
00459     
00460   [self lock];
00461   rawInput.getSource().setInputs((const float**)floatBufferData, inNumberFrames, numInputChannels);
00462  }
00463  else
00464  {
00465   memset(floatBuffer, 0, numInputChannels * inNumberFrames * sizeof(float));
00466   [self lock];
00467  }
00468  
00469  postFadeOutput.setOutputs(floatBufferData, inNumberFrames, 2);
00470  
00471  const int numOthers = others.size();
00472  for(int i = 0; i < numOthers; i++)
00473  {
00474   others[i].prepareAndProcessBlock(inNumberFrames, blockID);
00475  }  
00476  
00477  preFadeOutput.prepareAndProcessBlock(inNumberFrames, blockID);
00478  postFadeOutput.prepareAndProcessBlock(inNumberFrames, blockID);
00479  
00480  [self unlock];
00481  
00482  audioFloatToShortChannels(floatBufferData, ioData, inNumberFrames, ioData->mNumberBuffers);
00483    
00484  return err; 
00485 }

00487 - (void)propertyCallback:(AudioSessionPropertyID)inID
00488     withSize:(UInt32)inDataSize 
00489    withProperty:(const void *)inPropertyValue
00490 { 
00491  if(!isRunning) return;
00492  
00493  if(inPropertyValue)
00494  {
00495   CFDictionaryRef routeChangeDictionary  = (CFDictionaryRef)inPropertyValue;
00496   CFNumberRef     routeChangeReasonRef   = 
00497   (CFNumberRef)CFDictionaryGetValue (routeChangeDictionary, 
00498              CFSTR (kAudioSession_AudioRouteChangeKey_Reason));
00499   
00500   SInt32 routeChangeReason;
00501   CFNumberGetValue(routeChangeReasonRef, kCFNumberSInt32Type, &routeChangeReason);
00502   
00503   CFStringRef newAudioRoute;
00504   UInt32 propertySize = sizeof (CFStringRef);
00505   AudioSessionGetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_AudioRoute, &propertySize, &newAudioRoute);
00506   
00507   printf("route=%s\n", CFStringGetCStringPtr(newAudioRoute, CFStringGetSystemEncoding()));
00508   
00509 //  if (routeChangeReason == kAudioSessionRouteChangeReason_OldDeviceUnavailable)
00510 //   [self fixAudioRouteIfSetToReceiver];
00511  }
00512  
00513  UInt32 size = sizeof(UInt32);
00514  AudioSessionGetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_CurrentHardwareInputNumberChannels, &size, &numInputChannels);
00515  AudioSessionGetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_CurrentHardwareOutputNumberChannels, &size, &numOutputChannels);
00516  AudioSessionGetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_AudioInputAvailable, &size, &audioInputIsAvailable);
00517  
00518  printf("inputs=%d outputs=%d audioInputIsAvailable=%d\n", (int)numInputChannels, (int)numOutputChannels, (int)audioInputIsAvailable);
00519  
00520  if(rioUnit) AudioComponentInstanceDispose(rioUnit);
00521  
00522  rioUnit = NULL;
00523  
00524  [self setFormat];
00525  [self setupRemoteIO];
00526  
00527  rawInput.setSource(AudioIn::AR(numInputChannels), true);
00528  postFadeOutput = Plug::AR(UGen::emptyChannels(numOutputChannels), false);
00529  postFadeOutput.fadeSourceAndRelease(preFadeOutput, fadeInTime);
00530  
00531  AudioSessionSetActive(true);
00532  AudioOutputUnitStart(rioUnit);
00533  
00534 }

00581 - (id)initAudio

00596  
00597  [self fixAudioRouteIfSetToReceiver];

00601  
00602  //Float32 bufferDuration = DEFAULT_BUFFERSIZE / hwSampleRate;
00603  Float32 bufferDuration = preferredBufferSize / hwSampleRate;
00604  AudioSessionSetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_PreferredHardwareIOBufferDuration, sizeof(bufferDuration), &bufferDuration);
00605

00607  AudioSessionGetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_CurrentHardwareInputNumberChannels, &size, &numInputChannels);
00608  AudioSessionGetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_CurrentHardwareOutputNumberChannels, &size, &numOutputChannels);
